title: SupplyShortfall
description: A base-level upkeep shortfall sitrep (CONTRACTS §6; ECONOMY EC-6a; NX-436, Q-TD-51 U5, Q-TD-64). A shortfall episode at a base is the run of consecutive economy windows in which at least one unit of `side` homed there is grounded (the NX-437 harness definition, GLOSSARY). STARTED once per episode, never per unit: the sitrep "<BASE> OUT OF SUPPLY: n flights grounded. Haul to <BASE>". ENDED once, only for an announced episode that closed because its home paid a grounded unit again: the payoff line crediting credit_ids. An ENEMY base's episode is announced, and closed, only in a window in which the coalition tracks a live Static unit or facility at that base (FOW-13). An episode starting within economy.shortfall_quiet_windows of the end of the base's last announced or muted one is never announced. Public view: this INTEL line.

side.description: The side whose units the base grounds.

node_id.description: The base: the grounded units' home (ECONOMY EC-5). Nodes are public (FOW-10).

status.description: STARTED: the episode is announced; ENDED: its payoff.

grounded.description: STARTED: the units of `side` homed at the base grounded at that window; for an ENEMY base only those the coalition currently tracks, so possibly 0 (FOW-13). ENDED: 0.

credit_ids.description: ENDED, COALITION only: the carriers of `side` that unloaded stock into the base's stock during the episode, ascending, no duplicates (producer; not uniqueItems, SC-14), the 32 lowest ids; consumers resolve callsigns. Empty for STARTED and for an ENEMY base (always sent).
